items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Georgie Stole, he was the first guy that ever gave a black guy a chance to be a contractor for a musical scene in pictures in Hollywood and that happened to be me at the time.

ctx.x: the parking lot with his brand new Dusenbery convertible and he now lives up around the Morrell Castle (PHONETIC), up North here. As a matter of fact, he's the owner of part of the old Morrell Castle.

Georgie Stole, he was the first guy that ever gave a black guy a chance to be a contractor for a musical scene in pictures in Hollywood and that happened to be me at the time. It was at one of the freelance studios and it featured Louis Armstrong in a street scene, a walking scene, in 1937, '38 period. I contracted the band, which was a walking band, 45 pieces, and we made the recordings and everything for it. I can thank him for being so nice. That was Georgie Stole.
Do you remember the name of the picture?
